Future<void> run(rows, client) async {
 for (var row in rows) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  row = await enrich(row);
 }
 for (final raw in rows) {
  var row = raw;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  row = await normalize(row);
 }
 String? cursor;
 for (final item in rows) {
  cursor = await client.next(item, cursor);
 }
 for (final item in rows) {
  cursor = null;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  cursor = await client.next(item, cursor);
 }
}
